entries.en: The market stall sells taro beside the sweet potatoes.
entries.zh: 这个市场摊位在红薯旁边卖芋头。

entries.en: A calamitous flood destroyed the village's only bridge.
entries.zh: 一场灾难性的洪水摧毁了村里唯一的桥。

entries.en: The appendix presents the survey results in tabular form.
entries.zh: 附录以表格形式呈现调查结果。

entries.en: The drawer held a mishmash of keys, buttons, and coins.
entries.zh: 抽屉里放着钥匙、纽扣和硬币等杂物。

entries.en: Our nearsighted guide put on glasses to read the distant sign.
entries.zh: 我们那位近视的导游戴上眼镜看远处的标牌。

entries.en: The medieval painting shows sinners surrounded by hellfire.
entries.zh: 这幅中世纪绘画描绘了被地狱之火包围的罪人。

entries.en: The nurse placed a clean applicator on the tray.
entries.zh: 护士把一个干净的涂药器放在托盘上。

entries.en: After demobilization, many soldiers returned to their former jobs.
entries.zh: 复员后，许多士兵回到原来的工作岗位。

entries.en: The school closure reflects decades of depopulation in the valley.
entries.zh: 这所学校的关闭反映了山谷地区数十年来的人口下降。

entries.en: A narrow trail crossed the scrubby hillside above the farm.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的小径穿过农场上方灌木丛生的山坡。

entries.en: The contractor negligently left the gate unlocked overnight.
entries.zh: 承包商粗心大意地让大门整夜没有上锁。

entries.en: The laboratory compared spectroscopic measurements from both samples.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了两个样本的光谱测量结果。

entries.en: Threshing continued in the barn after the rain began.
entries.zh: 下雨后，谷仓里的脱粒工作仍在继续。

entries.en: The costume designer adjusted the dress for a busty performer.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为一位胸部丰满的表演者调整了裙子。

entries.en: A dirk lay beside the officer's gloves in the display case.
entries.zh: 陈列柜里，军官的手套旁放着一把短剑。

entries.en: The signalman watched the train approach the junction.
entries.zh: 信号手注视着列车驶近铁路交叉口。

entries.en: We moved the wicker chairs into the sunroom for winter.
entries.zh: 我们把藤椅搬进日光浴室过冬。

entries.en: The team used an iterative process to refine the prototype.
entries.zh: 团队通过反复的过程改进原型。

entries.en: The club removed the disputed names from its blacklist.
entries.zh: 俱乐部从黑名单中删除了那些有争议的名字。

entries.en: My pedometer recorded six thousand steps during the museum visit.
entries.zh: 参观博物馆期间，我的步数计记录了六千步。

entries.en: Each volunteer wore a yellow armband at the entrance.
entries.zh: 每位志愿者都在入口处戴着黄色臂章。

entries.en: A sparkler flickered beside the cake at the outdoor celebration.
entries.zh: 户外庆祝活动中，一支烟火在蛋糕旁闪烁。

entries.en: A small protrusion on the handle made it uncomfortable to grip.
entries.zh: 手柄上的一个小突出部使它握起来不舒服。

entries.en: The anesthetist will anesthetize the patient before the operation.
entries.zh: 麻醉师将在手术前对患者实施麻醉。

entries.en: A classicist helped us translate the inscription on the vase.
entries.zh: 一位古典学者帮助我们翻译花瓶上的铭文。

entries.en: Moving the piano required both careful planning and considerable brawn.
entries.zh: 搬动钢琴既需要周密计划，也需要相当大的体力。

entries.en: A gnarly oak stood beside the abandoned stone cottage.
entries.zh: 废弃的石屋旁矗立着一棵多瘤的橡树。

entries.en: The guests arrived stylishly dressed for the gallery opening.
entries.zh: 宾客们穿着时髦，前来参加画廊开幕式。

entries.en: Our team played wretchedly throughout the first half.
entries.zh: 我们队在整个上半场都打得很差。

entries.en: The carpenter marked the damaged section of the doorjamb.
entries.zh: 木匠标出了门侧柱受损的部分。

entries.en: The fishing boats left the harbor just before sunup.
entries.zh: 渔船在日出前不久驶离港口。

entries.en: The final clue was a poser even for experienced contestants.
entries.zh: 最后一条线索甚至难住了经验丰富的参赛者。

entries.en: The smaller firm hoped to outflank its rivals with faster deliveries.
entries.zh: 这家较小的公司希望凭借更快的交货速度智胜竞争对手。

entries.en: The faded postmark showed that the letter came from Bristol.
entries.zh: 褪色的邮戳表明这封信来自布里斯托尔。

entries.en: The play ends with the king confronting a faithless adviser.
entries.zh: 剧终时，国王与一个不忠的顾问当面对质。

entries.en: A guest stumbled drunkenly against the coat rack.
entries.zh: 一位宾客醉醺醺地踉跄着撞上了衣帽架。

entries.en: The assemblyman answered questions about the proposed transport budget.
entries.zh: 这位议员回答了有关拟议交通预算的问题。

entries.en: The rescued dog had boney legs and a tangled coat.
entries.zh: 获救的狗腿部瘦骨嶙峋，毛发纠结。

entries.en: The salesman was a smoothie who always remembered a customer's name.
entries.zh: 那个推销员油嘴滑舌，总能记住顾客的名字。

entries.en: The essay examines ethnocentrism in nineteenth-century travel writing.
entries.zh: 这篇文章探讨了十九世纪游记中的民族优越感。

entries.en: The archive holds the proclamation announcing the law's promulgation.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着宣布该法律颁布的公告。

entries.en: I found my hairbrush under the bathroom cabinet.
entries.zh: 我在浴室柜下面找到了发刷。

entries.en: The artist mixed ocher with oil for the background.
entries.zh: 画家将赭土与油混合，用来绘制背景。

entries.en: The exact attendance is knowable from the ticket records.
entries.zh: 从票务记录中可以得知确切的到场人数。

entries.en: The landlord's litigious reputation worried several prospective tenants.
entries.zh: 房东好打官司的名声让几位潜在租客感到担忧。

entries.en: The audience gasped audibly when the curtain fell.
entries.zh: 幕布落下时，观众发出了清晰可闻的惊呼声。

entries.en: The engineer measured the electrostatic charge on the plastic sheet.
entries.zh: 工程师测量了塑料薄片上的静电电荷。

entries.en: The chef placed a small mound of wasabi beside the fish.
entries.zh: 厨师在鱼肉旁边放了一小团山葵。

entries.en: The agreement includes a reaffirmation of both parties' earlier commitments.
entries.zh: 协议中包括双方对先前承诺的再次确认。

entries.en: The wartime diary belonged to a bombardier stationed overseas.
entries.zh: 这本战时日记属于一名驻扎海外的投弹手。

entries.en: The university appointed a docent to teach medieval history.
entries.zh: 大学任命了一名讲师教授中世纪历史。

entries.en: Residents protested against the militarization of the border region.
entries.zh: 居民抗议边境地区的军事化。

entries.en: A sightseer stopped to photograph the old railway station.
entries.zh: 一位观光客停下来拍摄那座老火车站。

entries.en: The architect's traditionalism is evident in the building's symmetrical facade.
entries.zh: 这位建筑师的传统主义体现在建筑对称的立面上。

entries.en: The diagram illustrates the interrelation of rainfall, soil, and vegetation.
entries.zh: 这张图展示了降雨、土壤与植被之间的相互关系。

entries.en: One accurate forecast does not establish the model's infallibility.
entries.zh: 一次准确的预测并不能证明这个模型绝不会出错。

entries.en: The teacher asked which numbers were divisible by six.
entries.zh: 老师问哪些数能被六整除。

entries.en: The dancers rehearsed a mambo for the summer festival.
entries.zh: 舞者们为夏日节庆排练了一支曼博舞。

entries.en: The presenter spoke conversationally, using the language of everyday discussion.
entries.zh: 主持人用日常交谈的语言，以会话的方式讲话。

entries.en: The specialist described the tumor as inoperable during the consultation.
entries.zh: 会诊时，专科医生表示这个肿瘤无法通过手术治疗。

entries.en: The thicker wall caused greater attenuation of the radio signal.
entries.zh: 较厚的墙壁造成了更大的无线电信号衰减。

entries.en: The butcher set aside two fryers for our order.
entries.zh: 肉贩为我们的订单留出了两只适合油炸的鸡。

entries.en: The report records a fivefold increase in bicycle rentals.
entries.zh: 报告记录了自行车租赁量增至五倍的情况。

entries.en: The waiter lifted the lid from the porcelain soup tureen.
entries.zh: 服务员揭开了瓷汤碗的盖子。

entries.en: The critic tartly dismissed the film as an expensive advertisement.
entries.zh: 评论家刻薄地把这部电影贬为一则昂贵的广告。

entries.en: The interview ended with an unscripted exchange about local football.
entries.zh: 采访以一段关于本地足球的即兴交谈结束。

entries.en: The surgical record notes the ligation of a blood vessel.
entries.zh: 手术记录记载了一处血管的结扎。

entries.en: The ceramist signed the base of each handmade bowl.
entries.zh: 陶瓷制作者在每只手工碗的底部签了名。

entries.en: The tennis final reached a tiebreaker in the opening set.
entries.zh: 网球决赛的首盘进入了抢七局。

entries.en: In kinesiology class, we analyzed the movement of the shoulder.
entries.zh: 在运动机能学课上，我们分析了肩部的运动。

entries.en: The researchers tested whether the association reflected a causative mechanism.
entries.zh: 研究人员检验了这一关联是否反映了致因机制。

entries.en: The recipe calls for grated suet and dried currants.
entries.zh: 食谱要求使用磨碎的板油和葡萄干。

entries.en: We chose taupe for the walls of the reading room.
entries.zh: 我们为阅览室的墙壁选择了褐灰色。

entries.en: The fisherman rowed a dory toward the sheltered cove.
entries.zh: 渔民划着一艘平底小渔船驶向避风的海湾。

entries.en: The lawyer considered whether the published accusation was actionable.
entries.zh: 律师考虑了这项公开指控是否构成起诉的依据。

entries.en: The proposer explained the motion before the committee voted.
entries.zh: 委员会投票前，提案人解释了这项动议。

entries.en: A single stalactite hung above the underground pool.
entries.zh: 一根钟乳石悬在地下水池上方。

entries.en: The library hosted a travelogue illustrated with photographs of Iceland.
entries.zh: 图书馆举办了一场配有冰岛照片的旅行见闻讲座。

entries.en: The manager smiled complacently at the early sales figures.
entries.zh: 经理看着初期销售数字，自满地笑了。

entries.en: The family spent August at their dacha outside Moscow.
entries.zh: 这家人在莫斯科郊外的别墅里度过了八月。

entries.en: A wrecker arrived to tow the damaged car away.
entries.zh: 一辆救险车赶来拖走受损的汽车。

entries.en: The accountant checked which overdue fees were still collectable.
entries.zh: 会计核查了哪些逾期费用仍可收取。

entries.en: The editor moved the modifier closer to the noun.
entries.zh: 编辑把修饰语移到了更靠近名词的位置。

entries.en: The volunteers' selflessness kept the shelter open through winter.
entries.zh: 志愿者们的无私奉献使收容所在整个冬季都能开放。

entries.en: The morning light revealed the loveliness of the mountain lake.
entries.zh: 晨光展现了山间湖泊的美丽。

entries.en: The watchmaker examined the tiny gears under a magnifying glass.
entries.zh: 钟表匠用放大镜检查那些微小的齿轮。

entries.en: Chickens turned slowly on the rotisserie behind the counter.
entries.zh: 柜台后面的轮转烤肉器上，鸡正缓缓转动。

entries.en: The counselor maintained a nonjudgmental tone throughout the conversation.
entries.zh: 咨询师在整个谈话中保持了不带评判的语气。

entries.en: The diagram labels the flexor that bends the finger.
entries.zh: 这张图标出了使手指弯曲的屈肌。

entries.en: The expedition crossed a roadless region north of the lake.
entries.zh: 考察队穿越了湖泊以北一片没有道路的地区。

entries.en: The guard shook the snow from a heavy greatcoat.
entries.zh: 卫兵抖掉了厚大衣上的雪。

entries.en: The dermatologist asked when the psoriasis first appeared.
entries.zh: 皮肤科医生询问银屑病最早是什么时候出现的。

entries.en: A row of gabled houses faced the canal.
entries.zh: 一排有山形墙的房屋面朝运河。

entries.en: The dancer wore a shimmery scarf under the stage lights.
entries.zh: 舞者在舞台灯光下围着一条微微发亮的围巾。

entries.en: The nurse spoke soothingly while the patient waited.
entries.zh: 患者等待时，护士用安慰的语气说着话。

entries.en: A loose hubcap rattled as the car crossed the bridge.
entries.zh: 汽车过桥时，一个松动的毂盖发出咔嗒声。

entries.en: The novel's supposed weakling carries an injured companion to safety.
entries.zh: 小说中那个被认为虚弱的人把受伤的同伴带到了安全的地方。

entries.en: A well-timed wisecrack eased the tension in the meeting.
entries.zh: 一句适时的俏皮话缓和了会议的紧张气氛。

entries.en: The historical novel follows a courtesan at the royal court.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说讲述了一位宫廷名妓的故事。

entries.en: The report describes stenosis in a section of the artery.
entries.zh: 报告描述了动脉某一段的狭窄。

entries.en: The technician felt unappreciated after another contribution went unmentioned.
entries.zh: 又一次贡献未获提及后，这位技术员感到不受赏识。

entries.en: The grammar chart marks each neuter noun with a green symbol.
entries.zh: 语法图表用绿色符号标出每个中性名词。

entries.en: The bursar prepared the university's annual financial statement.
entries.zh: 财务主管编制了大学的年度财务报表。

entries.en: The setting sun cast a coppery glow across the water.
entries.zh: 夕阳在水面上洒下铜色的光。

entries.en: A banshee's cry echoes through the castle in the folktale.
entries.zh: 在这个民间故事中，报丧女妖的哭声回荡在城堡里。

entries.en: The statue depicts a runner wearing a simple loincloth.
entries.zh: 这尊雕像描绘了一位系着简单腰布的跑者。

entries.en: The essay's argumentation depends on a distinction between cost and value.
entries.zh: 这篇文章的论证依赖于成本与价值之间的区别。

entries.en: A leprechaun hides a golden key in the children's story.
entries.zh: 在这个儿童故事中，一个矮妖精藏了一把金钥匙。

entries.en: The experiment tested whether the treatment could detoxify the contaminated liquid.
entries.zh: 实验检验了这种处理能否去除受污染液体中的毒物。

entries.en: Several reviewers reacted unfavorably to the proposed ending.
entries.zh: 几位评论者对拟议的结局作出了否定的反应。

entries.en: The report lists the transactions and the income derived therefrom.
entries.zh: 报告列出了这些交易以及由此获得的收入。

entries.en: The actor's toga caught on the edge of the bench.
entries.zh: 演员的宽外袍挂在了长凳边缘。

entries.en: The class compared asexual reproduction with sexual reproduction in plants.
entries.zh: 课堂上比较了植物的无性生殖与有性生殖。

entries.en: In the novel, the guests gather for a seance after dinner.
entries.zh: 小说中，宾客们在晚餐后聚在一起举行降神会。

entries.en: Sorting the receipts was an unglamorous part of the job.
entries.zh: 整理收据是这份工作中乏味的一部分。

entries.en: The factory's new plan emphasizes waste minimization during production.
entries.zh: 工厂的新计划强调在生产过程中尽量减少浪费。

entries.en: The guided descent included an abseil down the quarry wall.
entries.zh: 这次有向导带领的下行活动包括沿绳滑下采石场岩壁。

entries.en: The crowd reacted irrationally to an unverified rumor.
entries.zh: 人群对一则未经证实的传言作出了不理性的反应。

entries.en: On quiet Sundays, I luxuriate in the warmth of the sunroom.
entries.zh: 在宁静的周日，我尽情享受日光浴室里的温暖。

entries.en: The mechanic hung the hacksaw above the workbench.
entries.zh: 机修工把钢锯挂在工作台上方。

entries.en: The hospital record gives appendicitis as the reason for admission.
entries.zh: 医院记录将阑尾炎列为入院原因。

entries.en: The river flooded the bottomland beyond the orchard.
entries.zh: 河水淹没了果园以外的洼地。

entries.en: The modeler added tiny windows to the miniature station.
entries.zh: 模型制作者给微缩车站加上了小窗户。

entries.en: The artist tested the fixative on a spare charcoal sketch.
entries.zh: 画家在一张备用炭笔画上试用了固定剂。

entries.en: The guide pointed to the acropolis above the ancient town.
entries.zh: 导游指向古镇上方的卫城。

entries.en: The lecture explored monotheism through several historical traditions.
entries.zh: 讲座通过几种历史传统探讨了一神论。

entries.en: A troubadour sings beside the castle gate in the painting.
entries.zh: 画中，一位行吟诗人在城堡大门旁歌唱。

entries.en: The hydrology department monitors rainfall across the river basin.
entries.zh: 水文学系监测整个流域的降雨情况。

entries.en: The corner pizzeria stays open after the cinema closes.
entries.zh: 电影院关门后，街角的比萨饼店仍然营业。

entries.en: We heard water burble beneath the little wooden bridge.
entries.zh: 我们听到小木桥下的水发出汩汩声。

entries.en: A townsman offered to show us the old market square.
entries.zh: 一位镇民主动提出带我们参观旧集市广场。

entries.en: The photograph contains an unidentifiable object near the shoreline.
entries.zh: 照片中靠近岸边的地方有一个无法辨认的物体。

entries.en: I ordered a cheese butty at the station cafe.
entries.zh: 我在车站咖啡馆点了一个奶酪三明治。

entries.en: The critic describes the novel's narrator as a misogynist.
entries.zh: 评论家将这部小说的叙述者描述为一个厌恶女人的人。

entries.meaningZh: 住在同一所房子里的人
entries.en: My housemate left a note beside the broken kettle.
entries.zh: 我的室友在坏掉的水壶旁留了一张便条。

entries.en: From the watchtower, the ranger could see smoke beyond the ridge.
entries.zh: 护林员从瞭望塔上能看到山脊那边的烟。

entries.en: The museum displayed a wax simulacrum of the explorer.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一尊探险家的蜡像。

entries.en: A honeymooner asked the receptionist about the sunset boat trip.
entries.zh: 一位度蜜月的游客向前台询问日落游船的情况。

entries.en: Cooking a familiar meal helped ease my homesickness.
entries.zh: 做一顿熟悉的饭菜有助于缓解我的乡愁。

entries.en: We stopped at a roadhouse on the highway for dinner.
entries.zh: 我们在公路边的一家客栈停下来吃晚饭。

entries.en: The investigation uncovered the falsification of several expense reports.
entries.zh: 调查发现了几份费用报告被伪造的情况。

entries.en: A musketeer in the historical painting stands beside a cannon.
entries.zh: 这幅历史画中的一名火枪步兵站在大炮旁。

entries.en: The course introduces cinematography through lighting and camera exercises.
entries.zh: 这门课程通过灯光和摄影机练习介绍电影制片术。

entries.en: Residents debated the commercialisation of the village's annual festival.
entries.zh: 居民们就村里年度节庆的商业化展开了讨论。

entries.en: The hospital opened a new unit for perinatal care.
entries.zh: 医院开设了一个新的围产期护理病区。

entries.en: The portrait captures the woman's prettiness without hiding individual features.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像展现了这位女子的漂亮，同时没有掩盖其个人特征。

entries.en: The pocketknife folded neatly into its wooden handle.
entries.zh: 这把随身小折刀整齐地折进了木柄里。

entries.en: Couples walked along the esplanade beside the sea.
entries.zh: 一对对伴侣沿着海边的平坦空地散步。

entries.en: The designer replaced the angular pattern with a curvilinear border.
entries.zh: 设计师将棱角分明的图案换成了曲线边框。

entries.en: The anatomy model shows an extensor on the back of the forearm.
entries.zh: 解剖模型展示了前臂背侧的一块伸肌。

entries.en: The medical chart records a caesarian delivery at the hospital.
entries.zh: 医疗记录记载了医院进行的一次剖腹产分娩。

entries.en: The school installed prefab classrooms beside the sports field.
entries.zh: 学校在运动场旁安装了预制教室。

entries.en: A white catamaran anchored just beyond the swimming area.
entries.zh: 一艘白色双体船停泊在游泳区外不远处。

entries.en: The manuscript describes the ceremonies surrounding the saint's canonization.
entries.zh: 手稿描述了这位圣人获追封时的相关仪式。

entries.en: The farmer repaired the fence around the pigsty.
entries.zh: 农民修好了猪舍周围的围栏。

entries.en: Purple flowers filled the flowerbed beside the library steps.
entries.zh: 图书馆台阶旁的花坛里开满了紫色花朵。

entries.en: The travelers planned to encamp near the river before sunset.
entries.zh: 旅行者们计划在日落前于河边扎营。

entries.en: A convulsive movement shook the patient's right arm.
entries.zh: 一次抽搐动作使患者的右臂抖动。

entries.en: A small pockmark remained on the actor's left cheek.
entries.zh: 演员的左脸颊上留着一个小麻坑。

entries.en: In the cartoon, an earthling teaches the alien to ride a bicycle.
entries.zh: 漫画中，一个地球人教外星人骑自行车。

entries.en: The clerk nodded resignedly and began sorting the files again.
entries.zh: 职员无奈地点点头，再次开始整理文件。

entries.en: The anatomist pointed out the talus in the ankle model.
entries.zh: 解剖学家在踝部模型中指出了距骨。

entries.en: The guests continued to prattle about television while dinner cooled.
entries.zh: 晚餐渐渐凉了，客人们仍在没完没了地闲聊电视节目。

entries.en: The agronomist compared soil samples from three neighboring fields.
entries.zh: 农艺师比较了三块相邻田地的土壤样本。

entries.en: The diagram shows the trachea above the two main bronchi.
entries.zh: 图中显示气管位于两条主支气管上方。

entries.en: Deer emerged from the brushy slope behind the cabin.
entries.zh: 鹿从小屋后矮林丛生的山坡走了出来。

entries.en: The butcher weighed a hindquarter before hanging it in the cold room.
entries.zh: 肉贩称量了一块后腿肉，然后把它挂进冷藏室。

entries.en: The historical report records an outbreak of typhoid in the port.
entries.zh: 这份历史报告记载了港口的一次伤寒暴发。

entries.en: The cardholder disputed a charge on the monthly statement.
entries.zh: 持卡人对月度账单上的一笔收费提出了异议。

entries.en: The laboratory sent the tissue for pathologic examination.
entries.zh: 实验室将这份组织送去进行病理检查。

entries.en: The team developed a repeatable method for measuring the gap.
entries.zh: 团队开发了一种可重复的间隙测量方法。

entries.en: A golden nimbus surrounds the saint's head in the mosaic.
entries.zh: 马赛克画中，圣人的头部周围有一道金色光轮。

entries.en: The restored carriage was luxuriously furnished with velvet seats.
entries.zh: 修复后的车厢配有天鹅绒座椅，布置豪华。

entries.en: The sculpture offers an objectification of fear through its distorted human figure.
entries.zh: 这座雕塑通过扭曲的人形将恐惧对象化。

entries.en: The mechanic removed the carburettor from the old engine.
entries.zh: 机修工从旧发动机上拆下了汽化器。

entries.en: The missionary traveled between coastal towns to evangelize.
entries.zh: 这位传教士往来于沿海城镇传福音。

entries.en: A brazier glowed beside the entrance to the winter market.
entries.zh: 冬季集市入口旁的一个火盆发着光。

entries.en: The shortstop's bobble allowed the runner to reach first base.
entries.zh: 游击手的漏接让跑垒员跑上了一垒。

entries.en: The travelers slept in a yurt near the mountain lake.
entries.zh: 旅行者们睡在山间湖泊附近的一座蒙古包里。

entries.meaningZh: 扮演天真姑娘的女演员
entries.en: The ingenue rehearsed the balcony scene with the director.
entries.zh: 那位扮演天真姑娘的女演员与导演排练了阳台上的一场戏。

entries.en: The villagers hid their grain when a marauder approached.
entries.zh: 掳掠者靠近时，村民们藏起了粮食。

entries.en: I unthinkingly put the empty carton back in the fridge.
entries.zh: 我不假思索地把空纸盒放回了冰箱。

entries.en: The consultation covered the proposed lumpectomy and the patient's questions.
entries.zh: 会诊内容涵盖了拟进行的乳房肿瘤切除术及患者的问题。

entries.en: Heating the empty warehouse all winter would be uneconomical.
entries.zh: 整个冬天都给空仓库供暖会很不经济。
